en-US.description: Fishstrap is a Bloxstrap fork aiming to enhance some of the features.
en-US.name: Fishstrap
en-US.releaseNotes:
Another day, another Fishstrap update. You can now invite friends to your games using Discord invites and create desktop shortcuts for your favorite games.
Additions

Discord invites
Invite your friends to play any Roblox game with you through Discord. Turn on Allow Discord invites option in the Integrations tab, then send an invite from any chat or let your friends Ask to Join from your profile. Works in public servers and in private servers you joined from the website.
Warning
It has some limitations!
1. This feature will not work if whoever wants to join doesn't have Fishstrap installed and didn't play a game using Fishstrap with Discord Rich Presence enabled at least once.
2. Joining from Discord on mobile or on Linux is not supported.
3. Reserved servers or private servers you joined from inside the Roblox app are not supported either.

Game shortcuts
Paste a Roblox game link in the Shortcuts tab and Fishstrap will add a shortcut to your desktop, with the game's name and icon, that launches you straight into it.

Fixes
- Fixed games using BloxstrapRPC not being able to set custom Discord Rich Presence after Roblox renamed its log entry. (#1510)
- Fixed Fishstrap failing to check for Roblox updates when the first attempt didn't go through.
